title: Seth's Craftables
description: This project aims to add recipes for things that are not normally craft-able, for example, totems of undying are not craft-able, and this mod changes that!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5a156eefd7ee05a47346e9c02668208f28234d5c.png)


This project aims to add recipes for things that are not normally craft-able, for example, totems of undying are not craft-able, and this mod changes that!

Now, you might think thats its one of them low effort mods that just add lazy recipes, but its not! _(i sure hope so anyway)_

This mod aims to make the player to put a little more effort then putting 2 iron nuggets, 3 leather and 1 string to make a saddle, it aims to bring a more refined feel to the crafting proces of items, that are normally not craftable.

More recipies will come with more updates, and i am very much so open to comunity feedback, to changes, suggestions, and co-operation.

I hope you enjoy this mod, and good luck crafting!



-=-=-=-=-=-=

As of now, the mod supports the following:

Forge - 1.20.1
NeoForge - 1.21.1

-=-=-=-=-=-=

JEI RECOMENDED

PL (Polish)
EN (English)

i'd be happy to translate more, upon request, and ofcourse i would apriciate help.
